en.title: Log Ingestion and Query
en.description:
Append logs in order and run closed-interval queries; service/level match exactly, keyword does a substring match on message, and `*` means no filter.

This site's standard input/output format and supplementary bounds follow this problem's description.
en.input: The first line contains q (1≤q≤5000, a bound set by this site to cap the time of direct queries), and each of the next q lines is ADD timestamp service level message or QUERY start end service|* level|* keyword|*. message may contain spaces.
en.output: For each QUERY, output the number of matches on one line.
en.explanation: Maintain the appended logs in order; each query scans the current logs and checks the time, service, level, and message conditions entry by entry. The time range is a closed interval. Each query is O(L), and the total complexity is O(q²), which fits the simplified version directly defined by this problem.
